Hi Lotus Travel Team,

I hope you are having a great week. I recently came across the Marketing Analytics Intern opening at Lotus Travel and wanted to reach out directly to express my strong interest in joining your team. 

During my time as an Operations Analyst Intern at Tidepool Logistics, I wrote SQL queries to track delayed shipments and presented my findings to a team of 10 in PowerPoint. I also built a Google Analytics 4 and Looker Studio dashboard for a student club's website, and I am very comfortable using tools like SQL, Google Analytics 4, and Looker Studio. 

I would love to be considered for this role and chat about how my background can support Lotus Travel. Thank you for your time and consideration!

Best,
Alex Rao
